# Citus comparison

Advertised Citus configurations. No Citus deployment has been executed by the comparative benchmark runner.

Every comparative result published before 2026-11-01 was withdrawn; the records are retained as forensic evidence. The append-only [invalidation ledger](../../data/tidb-comparison/invalidations.ndjson) has 9 entries; 7 of them name the defect ids behind the withdrawal and 6 of them enumerate the withdrawn records by id (the rest name them by file and campaign commit). 5 of 20 history records are withdrawn without a ledger entry, by the admission rule `forensic-record-not-admissible`: no history record is admissible as a current claim.

![Citus comparison](citus-comparison-progress.svg)

## Cell status vocabulary

- `valid-observed`: admitted from retained v2 observations
- `product-failure`: the product ran and failed; failure counts are shown
- `invalid-measurement`: evidence exists but cannot support the claim (reason codes name why)
- `blocked`: cannot be measured until a named prerequisite exists
- `unsupported`: the configuration cannot express this claim
- `not-measured`: no observation exists
